creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the 10-17 Claude Code sighting on a_2cP6w1lHN (duplicate wakes), traced 2026-10-21. When a ring's Return is lost - behind Claude Code's 'Heads up' banner, for one - its text stays in the prompt, and the next Return anybody presses, or the doorbell's own send_left, sends a wake that is out of date: the agent read the messages meanwhile, and starts a turn for nothing. Proposal: take back (Backspace) a left ring whose group has nothing unread for that agent, instead of sending it. The doorbell already erases a ring typed at work whose message was read before its Return (doorbell.rs module doc); this extends that to a ring left at an idle prompt. Related: the feedback board's a_2iUefqPcQ (a late urgent ring).
title: A ring left in a Claude Code prompt is sent after its messages were read
